info.title: Setra API
info.description: Invoices, payments and automatic books on Monad: customers, invoices, orders, payments, matching, books, reconciliation, financial events and webhooks. Amounts are decimal strings. Test keys (sk_test_) operate on Monad testnet; live keys (sk_live_) on Monad mainnet.
